tasks.title: Model the activity log
tasks.description: Add server/src/models/activityModel.ts: the closed ACTIVITY_ACTIONS list, workspace/actor/action/summary, task/project/sprint references, the change sub-document (field 40, values 200), ip and userAgent, the four compound indexes, the 365-day TTL index and MAX_CHANGE_VALUE/ACTIVITY_RETENTION_DAYS.

tasks.title: Implement recordActivity and its pure helpers
tasks.description: Add server/src/utils/activity.ts: formatChangeValue (dates as YYYY-MM-DD, lists comma-separated, capped), diffFields, auditLookup, the onActivity listener registry and recordActivity, which truncates summary/ip/user agent and never throws.

tasks.title: Model automation rules
tasks.description: Add server/src/models/automationModel.ts: TRIGGER_TYPES, CONDITION_FIELDS, CONDITION_OPS, ACTION_TYPES, the caps (25 rules, 80-character name, 5 conditions, 5 actions, 40-character values, 500-character comments) and the (workspace, enabled, createdAt) index.

tasks.title: Write the pure rule engine
tasks.description: Add server/src/utils/automation/engine.ts: eventsFromActivity, matchesTrigger, matchesConditions and planActions over the rule and a task snapshot, including the MAX_LABELS cap, member-only assignment and the change list that mirrors the audit shape.

tasks.title: Validate rule input
tasks.description: Add server/src/utils/automation/validate.ts: parseTrigger (allowed `to` values per trigger type), parseConditions (operator per field, allowed values) and parseActions (value kind per action), each returning a readable error.

tasks.title: Run rules from the activity stream
tasks.description: Add server/src/utils/automation/register.ts: subscribe once per process, keep MAX_AUTOMATION_DEPTH and a per-request fired set, re-read the task per rule, skip epics and other projects, apply the plan in one update with completedAt sync and child backlogging, and record automation.ran plus task.updated.

tasks.title: Add the rule template catalog
tasks.description: Add server/src/utils/automation/templates.ts with the seven ready-made recipes (bug priority, assignment on start, blocked label on completion, high-priority label, comment reopens, reviewed completes, assigned starts).

tasks.title: Cover the engine and the log with unit tests
tasks.description: Add server/src/__tests__/automationEngine.test.ts and server/src/__tests__/activity.test.ts for the pure matching/planning functions, diffFields and formatChangeValue.

tasks.title: Implement the automation controller
tasks.description: Add server/src/controllers/automationController.ts: validation chains, present() projection, workspace cap, checkAssignees against req.workspace.members, list/templates/create/update/delete, and activity recording for created/updated/deleted.

tasks.title: Declare the automation routes
tasks.description: Add server/src/routes/automationRoutes.ts (templates before /:id) with protect + requirePermission('settings:manage') on every route and mount it at /:slug/automations in server/src/routes/workspaceRoutes.ts.

tasks.title: Serve task history and the workspace log
tasks.description: Add server/src/controllers/activityController.ts: getTaskActivity (tasks:read, task must exist in the workspace) and getWorkspaceActivity (settings:manage, area/actor/before filters, retentionDays and areas in the response), both cursor-paged with limit+1.

tasks.title: Add the CSV export
tasks.description: Implement toAuditCsv (quote every cell, double inner quotes, neutralise leading = + - @ tab CR), the format=csv branch with the 5000-row cap, BOM, dated filename and the audit.exported entry recorded before responding.

tasks.title: Mount the audit routes
tasks.description: Add GET /:slug/activity in server/src/routes/workspaceRoutes.ts (settings:manage) and GET /:id/activity in server/src/routes/taskRoutes.ts (tasks:read).

tasks.title: Cover rules and the log with integration tests
tasks.description: Add server/src/__integration__/automations.test.ts (access, CRUD, running, workspace isolation) and server/src/__integration__/activity.test.ts (task activity, workspace log, filter behavior).

tasks.title: Build the automations feature module
tasks.description: Add client/src/features/automations: api, useAutomations, lib/options (labels, trigger/condition/action options and value kinds), lib/draft (empty draft, draft from rule/template, validateDraft, toInput), lib/describe and the RuleBuilder/RuleList/RuleSwitch/TemplateGallery components.

tasks.title: Add the automations page
tasks.description: Add client/src/pages/AutomationsPage.tsx using useAuthGuard + Sidebar, listing rules with their descriptions, toggling enabled, deleting with confirmation and opening the builder or a template.

tasks.title: Build the audit feature module
tasks.description: Add client/src/features/audit: api (list, exportCsv, downloadBlob), useAuditLog, lib/filters (parse/write URL params, hasActiveFilters), lib/format (area/action labels, change descriptions, day grouping, entry links) and the table, list, filter bar, entry sheet, pagination and skeleton components.

tasks.title: Add the audit log page with CSV download
tasks.description: Add client/src/pages/AuditLogPage.tsx: URL-persisted filters, day grouping, entry sheet, older/newer paging and the CSV download through a Blob, with the phone layout handled by useIsPhone.
